messages:
alex: Heads up 1: we just got paged for increased 5xxs on hosted inference. Error spike started ~14:03 UTC. I'm opening this thread to coordinate customer comms and the post-incident follow-up.

maria: Thanks. Can someone grab the timeline + the immediate mitigation notes? I'll draft the status page and a short customer follow-up.

sam: On-call here. Paging logs show autoscaler activity and multiple pod restarts. I rolled a quick config revert for the scaling policy at 14:07 UTC which stopped the blast of 5xxs.

support-bot: 4 customer-facing alerts created: INC-2026-1101, INC-2026-1102, INC-2026-1103, INC-2026-1104. Linked to this thread.

cheng: From traces: root cause looks like a model-version handshake failure that left requests waiting on shard attachment; KV-cache eviction then amplified latency. First attach errors at 14:02:56 UTC.

jess: Support noted ~12 accounts saw degraded responses; two had retries fail. I'm collecting impacted customers and severity. Will DM the list (sensitive).

maria: Draft status page blurb (please comment):

```
Summary: We experienced a service degradation affecting hosted inference between ~14:0314:20 UTC. Some API requests returned 5xx errors and higher latency.
Status: Resolved (14:20 UTC).
Impact: A portion of requests were affected; a subset of customers experienced intermittent errors and latency. No user data loss detected.
Mitigation: Rolled back recent autoscaler policy change and reattached affected model shards; normal service restored at 14:20 UTC.
Next steps: Full internal RCA published within 24 hours; customers with confirmed impact will receive direct follow-up.
```

sam: Suggest removing 'reattached' and replacing with 'recovered shard assignments' for clarity.

maria: Updated above. Also adding a single-line note that were prioritizing account outreach.

maria: Draft short customer email (template):

```
Subject: Follow-up: brief disruption affecting Redwood hosted inference (Mar XX, 2026)

Hi <Customer>,

We want to follow up on a brief service disruption you may have observed between ~14:0314:20 UTC today. During this time, some API requests experienced elevated latency and intermittent 5xx errors.

What happened: Our autoscaling configuration change coincided with unexpected model-shard attach failures on a subset of nodes, which caused increased error rates while we recovered shard assignments.
Timeline: [brief bullets appended below]
What we did: Rolled back the autoscaler policy and recovered shard assignments; service returned to normal by 14:20 UTC.
Next steps: We are publishing a full RCA and will follow up directly if your account was impacted.

If you need further details or a postmortem call, reply and well set it up with your account team.

Thanks,
Redwood Inference Support
```

jess: I'll send that to impacted accounts after we finalize the timeline.

cheng: Compact timeline:
- 14:02:56 UTC  first shard-attach errors observed
- 14:03:10 UTC  customer-facing 5xx spike begins
- 14:07:05 UTC  autoscaler policy revert initiated
- 14:12:30 UTC  majority of routes show reduced error rates
- 14:20:00 UTC  service metrics returned to normal thresholds

maria: Internal RCA bullet points (short):
- Root cause: regression in autoscaler rollout that interacted with recent model deployment semantics causing shard attach timeouts.
- Immediate mitigation: revert autoscaler policy and force-reassign shards; temporarily increase attach timeouts to avoid cascade.
- Preventative actions: 1) Add canary gating for autoscaler policy changes; 2) Harden model attach logic with faster fallback to compatible model variant; 3) Alert on >2% attach failures in a 3m window; 4) Add runbook steps for faster vendor escalation.

sam: Also add autoscaler cooldown/jitter and stricter preflight checks when model deployments are in-progress.

deploy-bot: config-revert: autoscaler-policy-2026-03-11 performed by sam at 14:07:05 UTC

incident-bot: on-call handoff recorded: alex -> sam at 14:25 UTC. Handoff notes: monitoring normal, follow-up comms in progress.

maria: Approvals: can SRE and Product thumbs-up to publish status page + customer emails? Also need volunteer to own the internal RCA write-up (24h draft).

sam: :thumbsup: from SRE. I'll review the RCA draft.

olivia: (Product is out today; pinged via PM) :thumbsup: from Product PM (cc maria).

jess: I'll orchestrate customer outreach and tag the impacted accounts.

maria: Great. Plan: publish status page at 14:35 UTC, start targeted customer emails at 14:50 UTC, internal RCA draft in 24 hours (cheng to own), final RCA within 72 hours.

alex: Quick ask for the RCA: please include the minimal repro steps and the exact commit/rollout ID that triggered autoscaler change. We need that for postmortem.

cheng: Will attach logs, the autoscaler policy diff, and a repro case showing the attach timeout behavior.

jess: Noted - sending DMs to top impacted accounts and creating follow-up tickets.

maria: Status page posted at 14:35 UTC. Customer emails queued. Internal RCA owner assigned to cheng. Closing this coordination thread; Ill paste RCA link when available.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-1102 marked Resolved by sam at 14:35 UTC

maria: Thanks everyone. If anything changes, comment here and we'll reopen the thread.
